subject: literature
passage: The cabinet had come to Julian with the rest of his father's things, and for a year he had not opened it. When he finally did, he found forty shallow drawers of moths, each pinned in its row, and under almost none of them a label. His father had known every one by sight; he had never needed to write the names down. Julian, who had not inherited that knowledge, began to work through the drawers with a borrowed field guide, matching wing patterns to plates and writing the names on slips of card. It was slow. But somewhere around the eleventh drawer he noticed that he had stopped thinking of the task as sorting out an inheritance, and had begun to feel that he was finishing a conversation.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

choices.A: Julian uses a borrowed field guide to identify the moths that his father pinned in the drawers.
choices.B: In labeling his father's collection, Julian comes to feel connected to him rather than burdened by his belongings.
choices.C: Julian resents that his father never taught him the names of the moths in the collection.
choices.D: Julian discovers that he shares his father's ability to identify moths at a glance.

explanation.why: The text begins with Julian avoiding the cabinet for a year and treating its contents as his father's "things." As he labels the moths, his feeling changes: he stops seeing the task as "sorting out an inheritance" and begins to feel he is "finishing a conversation" with his father. The main idea is this shift from burden to connection.
explanation.A: Incorrect. This is an accurate detail of how he works, but it misses the change in feeling that the text builds toward.
explanation.B: Correct. The closing sentence marks the change from an inheritance to be sorted to a conversation to be finished.
explanation.C: Incorrect. The text never says Julian feels resentment; the ending suggests the opposite.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This reverses the text: Julian "had not inherited that knowledge" and needs a field guide.
